request-prompt: Increase the font size of stream titles and viewer count text, and move the viewer counts from the thumbnail overlay to a clean text line directly below the streamer's name.
goal: I choose what to watch by analyzing textual information and metrics, such as stream titles, tags, and exact viewer counts.
jobs: I want to discover live, non-gaming streams (such as travel, outdoor adventures, or casual chatting) to keep me entertained.
I want to find streams with specific tags or languages (like 'English', 'Travel', 'Outdoors') that match my current interests.
I want to check which popular creators in the 'Just Chatting & IRL' category are currently live and how many viewers they have.
I want to log in or sign up for a Twitch account so I can participate in the chat and interact with the community.
I want to search for a specific stream topic or creator on the platform.
I want to check recommended live channels in the sidebar to see if my favorite creators are streaming.

preference-pairs.a: I prefer watching small-to-medium channels where I can actively participate in chat and have a direct connection with the streamer.
preference-pairs.b: I prefer watching large, highly-viewed streams where I can lurk passively as a spectator in a fast-moving crowd without any expectation to interact.

preference-pairs.a: I am highly selective and rely on specific tags and descriptive titles to find niche hobbies or regional content that matches my exact interest.
preference-pairs.b: I am a casual viewer who browses broad, general entertainment categories to find whatever is currently trending or easy to watch in the background.

preference-pairs.a: I choose what to watch based primarily on visual cues, such as live stream thumbnails, previews, and creator avatars.
preference-pairs.b: I choose what to watch by analyzing textual information and metrics, such as stream titles, tags, and exact viewer counts.
